study: Randel et al. 2016 (= NCEE 2011-4005) — CASL classroom-assessment PD, Colorado cluster RCT, grade 4-5 math, CSAP
delivery_evidence: CASL is self-administered teacher PD implemented through in-school teacher learning teams that meet regularly face-to-face to study the CASL textbook/DVDs and apply practices, supported by a school facilitator (trained at a CASL-developer workshop); no online/remote delivery — DVDs are study materials, not the PD channel (intervention description; learning-team fidelity Sec. 3-4).
test_alignment_evidence: Outcome is the statewide Colorado Student Assessment Program (CSAP) mathematics scale score — a broad independent standardized accountability test not tailored to CASL (extraction test_type=standardized_independent; Table 4.1, p.67).
curriculum_evidence: CASL builds teachers' formative/classroom-assessment literacy and practice using their existing math curriculum; no new curriculum or instructional-materials package is provided (the CASL textbook/DVDs are PD content about assessment, not a student curriculum); comparison = business-as-usual PD (intervention description).
outcome_timing_evidence: Single primary outcome is spring-2009 CSAP math, measured at the end of the CASL implementation year (extraction timepoint=post, spring 2009, end of implementation year; Table 4.1).
